Why CareGist
Built to support a decision, not to sell rows
Change, not catalogue churn
CareGist is built around canonical events with stable CQC location IDs, rather than repeated exports of mutable provider rows.
Evidence travels with the signal
Source URL, observation times, and entity level support traceability. Reconciled snapshot metadata, including a checksum when available, is reported on Data Status.
Review Data Status
Safe when intelligence is incomplete
A verified raw event still ships if an explanation cannot meet the evidence gate. CareGist does not fill gaps with speculation.

Products
Two products, both built on the published record
CareGist sells two products: a weekly digest of movement in one England region, and a one-off brief on the accounts worth approaching in a territory.
Weekly
Weekly Digest · £
150
Four weekly digests covering one England region: new registrations, rating changes, and closures, each linking to the official CQC record.
See the Weekly Digest
Territory
Territory Opportunity Brief · £
745
A ranked shortlist of 25–50 priority organisations, plus a brief on territory size, structure, and notable movements, with the evidence behind each priority.
